name: Document Identification 10
definition: Identifies a document by a unique identification and a version together with the submitter of the document.|Also specifies the type of document and an index for easy referencing.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of a set of data.

Version.name: Version
Version.definition: Unambiguous identification of the version of a set of data. Example: Version 1.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Identifies the type of data set.

Submitter.name: Submitter
Submitter.definition: Uniquely identifies the financial institution which has submitted the set of data by using a BIC.

DocumentIndex.name: Document Index
DocumentIndex.definition: Index assigned to the document, to allow easy referencing.
